intro: A Hunter's Challenge is a timed hunting trial issued by the brash human Daryl the Youngling at Farstrider Lodge in southeastern Loch Modan. Annoyed by his own inability to belittle your previous success, Daryl wagers the shirt off his back that you cannot track and fell five elder mountain boars within twelve minutes. The task tests an adventurer's swiftness against the rugged terrain and dangerous wildlife of the highlands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friendath, is it? I can tell you're bursting with pride over completing the first test, hm? As I told you before, it's no large feat.
You should try your hand at boar hunting. Trust me, this is no Coldridge Valley boar hunt, so you'd best have a care with them. I'll give you just twelve minutes this time.
Don't feel bad if you fail. I'd give you the shirt off my back if you succeeded!
Have I ever related to you the story of how I received my famous scar? No? It was two years ago...

clips.title: Progress
paras: It's only natural to feel sorry for yourself when shown up by someone so new to this world. You shouldn't feel bad, friendah.
Hm? Did I get your name wrong?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You seem a bit worse for wear. No doubt the boars gave you some trouble, hm? No worries, I will be discreet about your struggle, I can imagine how hard it must be for you without the accusations of wagging tongues.
Oh! You managed to kill the boars? I... Well, that is... That is to say, I'm not surprised! Any child could have—bet?
